svg.title: stdx's DEFLATE against its baselines, on INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C
svg.desc: gzip decoding, in multiples of libdeflate's speed: ahead on 17, level on 7, behind on 15 of 39 files; 0.90 to 1.85. gzip encoding: speed in multiples of libdeflate's level 6, against compression ratio: no other library's point is both faster and smaller than any of stdx's 3 levels.
svg.text: stdx's DEFLATE against its baselines, on INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C
One job of run 45895089065 at commit fdfbb70. The line at 1 is the baseline each panel's title names; the axis is logarithmic.
gzip decoding, in multiples of libdeflate's speed
ahead on 17, level on 7, behind on 15 of 39 files; 0.90 to 1.85
gzip encoding: speed in multiples of libdeflate's level 6, against compression ratio
no other library's point is both faster and smaller than any of stdx's 3 levels
The number beside a point is its level. Up is smaller output, and right is faster.
† the benchmark repeats this file of 256 KiB or less, so the branch predictor learns it (decision 45)
▲ marks a row 5% or more faster than at v0.3.0, past the noise of both, ▼ one that much slower, and a dashed line its value at v0.3.0.
